Billy Brown just got out of jail. Now he’s going to serve some real time. He’s going home.

Lock your windows. Hide your daughters. Say your prayers.
2424: After their high school basketball coach passes away, five good friends and former teammates reunite for a Fourth of July holiday weekend.
Boys will be boys. . . some longer than others.

Trying to fit in. Born to stand out.

It started as a joke. Now the joke is on them.
Salt Lake City Police Desk Clerk

But when he finds himself torn between his longtime love and the widow of one of his victims, his plans go awry.
He chopped down the family tree...
The D'Ascoyne Family: The Duke / The Banker / The Parson / The General / The Admiral / Young Ascoyne / Young Henry / Lady Agatha
4216: Four female temps working for a credit company find their friendship threatened by the arrival of a new hire, who lands a permanent position one of the women was vying for.
Waiting for your life to change... can be a full time job.
4472: When a sudden plague of blindness devastates a city, a small group of the afflicted band together to triumphantly overcome the horrific conditions of their imposed quarantine.
Your vision of the world will change forever.
4728: In Imperial Russia, Anna, wife of the officer Karenin, goes to Moscow to visit her brother. On the way, she meets charming cavalry officer Vronsky, to whom she's immediately attracted. But in St. Petersburg’s high society, a relationship like this could destroy a woman’s reputation.
4984: A father and daughter live a perfect but mysterious existence in Forest Park, a beautiful nature reserve near Portland, Oregon, rarely making contact with the world. 5240: Several years after the tragic death of their little girl, a doll maker and his wife welcome a nun and several girls from a shuttered orphanage into their home, soon becoming the target of the doll maker's possessed creation—Annabelle.
You don't know the real story.

Lance Clayton is about to get everything he deserves.

When the St. Louis Browns lost Bing, the Cardinal got a good singer!

Mark Kendall just found out his one-night stand has been around for centuries.

6776: The true story of Forrest Tucker, from his audacious escape from San Quentin at the age of 70 to an unprecedented string of heists that confounded authorities and enchanted the public. 7032: A chance encounter between two strangers in Grand Central Terminal sparks a life-changing, nighttime sojourn through New York City. They grow into each other's most trusted confidants when an evening of unexpected adventure forces them to confront their fears and take control of their lives.

7288: A grieving mother transforms herself into a vigilante following the murders of her husband and daughter, eluding the authorities to deliver her own personal brand of justice.

7800: Dangerous missions are the bread and butter of the Thunderbirds, a high-tech secret force employed by the government. He'll soon discover that the Thunderbirds won't go down.
Climb into the driver's seat of the most advanced rescue vehicles on the planet.
8056: A group of student activists travel from New York City to the Amazon to save the rainforest.  However, once they arrive in this vast green landscape, they soon discover that they are not alone… and that no good deed goes unpunished.

Some fight for power. Some fight for us.

The man. The myth. The memoirs.
9336: The ongoing war between the canine and feline species is put on hold when they join forces to thwart a rogue cat spy with her own sinister plans for conquest.
Just like real spies... only furrier.

It couldn't happen... but it did!
9848: Suspecting that people are transforming into malevolent shape-shifters, Wyatt flees to New York City to seek out his estranged childhood friend Christian.

She'll get what she wants... no matter what it takes!

10616: An obsessed scientist conducts profane experiments in evolution, eventually establishing himself as the self-styled demigod to a race of mutated, half-human abominations.
TERROR! Stalked the Brush-Choked Island...Where Men Who Were Animals Sought the Girl Who Was All-Human!

Life doesn't come with a roadmap.

The greatest scandal in polka history.

Extermination is not just a business. It's a way of life

12408: A young Englishman plots revenge against his mysterious, beautiful cousin, believing that she murdered his guardian. But his feelings become complicated as he finds himself falling under the beguiling spell of her charms.

12920: A down-and-out businessman travels to a seaside town, where he meets a woman with unusual sexual powers.

From her LIPS — poison that bred MURDER!

13944: Two estranged sisters are forced to rob a bank in order to save their brother. But this is no ordinary bank.

A buddy movie without the buddies.

World War II ends and her story begins...

We are all products of our environment ...some environments are just harder to survive in

Undead…Yet living on the kisses of youth!
17528: Literary icon Joan Didion reflects on her remarkable career and personal struggles in this intimate documentary directed by her nephew, Griffin Dunne.
17784: During a war in an imaginary country, unscrupulous soldiers recruit poor farmers with promises of an easy and happy life. Two of these farmers write to their wives of their exploits.

18808: Teenage Julien loves his teenage cousin Julia among flowers in summer of '39 France.
19064: A struggling musician becomes a 12-year-old musical prodigy's guardian for a summer.
Some gifts come in extraordinary packages.
19320: A man who recently completed rebuilding a townhouse becomes obsessed with a rat infestation until it becomes an interspecies duel.
Two forces have claimed the house. Only one will survive.

A Controversial Thriller of Murder and Revenge.

20088: Lady Snowblood is caught by the police and sentenced to death for her crimes. As she is sent to the gallows she is rescued by the secret police who offer her a deal to assassinate some revolutionaries.
Born in prison on a snowy night, she's on an endless journey of carnage

Can their bromance overcome this love triangle.

When you're down to your last dream, you either live it or lose it.

One's tough ... One's smart... Together they unleash explosive action!

Kamao Toh Zero! Churao Toh Hero!
Jani Singh / Gogi Arora / Dr. B. D. Handa

Man is no longer in control!

No parents. No rules. No pulse.
23416: After an amazing first date, Bea and Ben’s fiery attraction turns ice cold — until they find themselves unexpectedly reunited at a destination wedding in Australia. So they do what any two mature adults would do: pretend to be a couple.
They only look like the perfect couple.

You get the ending you deserve.
24184: A struggling young dancer finds herself drawn in by dark forces when a peculiar, well-connected older couple promise her a shot at fame.
24440: After a public spat with a movie star,  a disgraced director retaliates by kidnapping the actor's daughter, filming the search for her in real-time.
24696: A musician plagued by insomnia is pulled into an odyssey with a stranger who begins to unravel the very core of his existence.
Reality lies deeper than you think.
24952: Tiffany "Rex" Simpson has always dreamed of going to space, and her "doctored" application lands her in NASA's ultra-competitive astronaut training program. 25208: After suffering humiliation by the crew Invincible, street dancer Ash looks to gather the best dancers from around the world for a rematch.
25464: Mykola is an eccentric pacifist who wants to be useful to humanity. On the battlefield, one bullet can change everything.
25976: Two adorable kids, a quirky mother-in-law and a happy-go-lucky friend help a heartbroken wife bring a straying husband back from the other woman's tangled embrace.
26232: After moving to Mumbai, an ambitious young man becomes the stock trader for a notorious businessman.
26488: A high profile defence lawyer is promised a Rajya Sabha seat if he wins a case of an accused with charges of killing two migrant children. However, there's much more than what meets the eye in this courtroom drama that explores the uncertainty of human mind and the journey of criminal discovery.
26744: Clara and her two sons escape from her abusive husband with little more than their car and plan to start over in New York. The ‘Winter Palace’ soon becomes a place of unexpected encounters between people who are all undergoing some sort of crisis and whom fate has now brought together.
A little help goes a long way.
27000: Jérémie returns to his hometown for the funeral of his former boss, the village baker. He decides to stay for a few days with Martine, the man's widow. A mysterious disappearance, a threatening neighbor and a priest with strange intentions make Jérémie's short stay in the village take an unexpected turn.
Some confessions come with a body count.
27256: Stranded in an abandoned building, six friends relate scary stories while a crazed killer lurks in the forest.
27512: A decade after the American Civil War, Edward Young returns home from a hunting trip to find a horrific reanimation of his wife and that their son Adam has disappeared. He must battle his way through an unexplainable outbreak of the walking dead.
History has a violent way of repeating itself.

An intimate journey of hope, rebellion, violence, transmission and sisterhood that will question the very foundations of our societies.
28024: The shooting of a U.S. senator's wife raises the stakes for kidnappers seeking a hefty ransom for a computer magnate.
Four million dollars the hard way in the Big Easy.
28280: The life of Shaji, a laid-back youngster, turns upside down when someone from his past pays him a visit.
28536: What a man is a comedy that tells the story of a young professor, Alex (Matthias Schweighofer), who after being left by his girlfriend Caroline (Mavie Hörbiger), begins a journey to know himself. 28792: Extrovert Corinne convinces Jane, a shy, talented baker, to commit to a year of bringing cakes to bars, to help her meet people and build confidence. But when Corinne receives a life-altering diagnosis, the pair faces a challenge unlike anything they've experienced before.
There’s no recipe for the perfect friendship.
29048: Rimants is more interested in playing rugby, listening to music and dealing on the black market than studying for school, but when he falls in love with Monika, his faith in love and the future is tested.
29304: Three couples from different economic backgrounds find ways to fix their relationships.
29560: Writer Claire Holloway is troubled by nightmares of Rose Marsh Farm. She decides to vacation at the farm which unbeknown to her is haunted by the ghost of a little girl and a teenage boy. Claire enlists the help of Geoffry Hunt to help uncover a decade old tragedy.
You can bury the past... but sometimes the past won't stay buried.
29816: Behind each person is a story , behind each story is a person , so we have to be patient before any judgment
30072: Sooraj Dhanrajgir, a playboy, falls in love with Komal, who rejects him because of his vices and gives him time to change. Things go awry when a little boy shows up claiming to be his son.
30328: In a world where an AI programme allows people to communicate with their deceased loved ones, a flight attendant and a mother question the meaning of reality and humanity.
Anytime, anywhere, you can meet them again.
30584: A disgraced merchant marine officer elects to stay aboard his sinking cargo ship in order to prove the vessel was deliberately scuttled and, as a result, vindicate his good name.
The Saga of the Derelict, Mary Deare... the strange secret she carried... the desperate voyage and plot to sink her!
30840: A teenage boy, raised by a mother who considers herself psychic, takes a bullied kid into his group of violent misfits. 31096: Amar, Akbar and Anthony are close friends living in Kochi. They enjoy a carefree life. Their perceptions and beliefs get shattered with an unexpected event and the resulting story forms the plot of the movie.
31352: A bump on the head sends Hank Martin, 1905 auto mechanic, to Arthurian England, 528 A.D., where he is befriended by Sir Sagramore le Desirous and gains power by judicious use of technology. Its laughter will ring through the centuries!
31608: A crack test pilot lands to find the planet has been devastated by unknown forces. There are a few survivors, so he organizes them in a plan to ward off control by a group of killer robots.
They came from the heavens... and sent the world into hell!
31864: Mercenary Nick Boon is trying to atone for his life as an enforcer for a ruthless syndicate. When he finds the pair living in fear of a criminal kingpin, Boon realizes the only way to protect them is to do what he does best: kill.
Vengeance was his past. Justice is his fate.

Reaching out from the shadows, the monster hunts the eight strangers as they race to escape the asylum.
You can't hide from your own shadow

Was It an Act of Violence or an Act of Love?

The celebration is diverse characters who live next to absurd situations.

An Orgy of the Damned!  It happens beyond madness - where your mind won't believe what your eyes see.
33912: Set in the 1950s, a a group of young girls in upstate New York form their own gang.
34168: A two-bit actor faces challenges after he is asked by Police to impersonate a look-alike gangster.

Seeing and looking at what others cannot bear to see is what my life is all about
34680: A writer who studies the paranormal believes that low frequency tactile sound is the cause for reported ghost sightings in an abandoned subway station. In an attempt to debunk the sightings, she breaks into the station to record evidence.

35192: A young man who gets easily scared is possessed by a ghost that is seeking revenge.

Terror Stalks Its Turreted Battlements... and Horror Crawls the Catacombs Beneath!

An android hunter from outer space is about to create hell on earth.

Sometimes a prank comes back to kill you.
37752: Career criminals and a local youth carefully plan and rehearse the robbery of a Missouri bank.
Never before in Police annals! Never before in film history!

Colder than ice, her kiss pierces the heart.

...from the Honky Tonks to the penthouses...the creeps, the hoods, the killers come out to war with the city!

Identity is a work of art.

39544: Indian mother Mrs Sethi's obsession with marrying off her daughter turns murderous. With jokes that routinely miss the mark and cringeworthy slapstick, this black comedy farce shouldn't work. Somehow, though, it does.
Finding the right man can be murder
39800: A happy-go-lucky guy lands in trouble after he locks horns with an egoistic lady.
40056: A circus becomes the location for stolen loot and murder.
The most horrifying syndicate of evil in history!
40568: A young woman dies by suicide and leaves all her belongings to her next-door neighbour, who becomes determined to investigate her reasons for taking her life.

One man, one life. A thousand memories

42104: A movie based on the italian sitcom "I Soliti Idioti".
Gianluca De Ceglie / Gisella Franchi / Fabio Rizzi / Giampietro Bianchi
Ruggero De Ceglie / Sebastiano Credici / Fabio Rizzato / Marialuce Bianchi
42616: After a chance encounter with a mysterious couple claiming to be old friends, Andrés and Ana are invited to spend the evening at a beautiful, secluded old villa. The roving romances of a two-fisted American!

Since Morgan is leaving for Zurich the same night, he decides to hide the secret plan in the heads of the dolls.
The No. 1 Song-and-Dance Clown at his best!
45944: After nearly a decade away, Kumail Nanjiani returns to Chicago, where he got his start in standup, in a new special that tackles anxiety, the perils of buying drugs pre-legalization, and most importantly, cat medication.

400 young brave hearts against a huge army

Jacques, ami, chauffeur et amant secret de Fleurette

The savage of "Bordertown" dynamites his way into the heart of humanity!
46968: Shahid struggles to find love in the Asian community due to the stigma of his divorce, several years prior.

This year, their peace is slightly disturbed by the proximity of a construction site where foreign workers are employed.  Xenophobic comments are made. One evening at the ball, a fight breaks out between Lajoie, Albert Schumacher and two algerian immigrant workers...

Danielle's sister Anna now must find a way to stop Crowe without killing her sister.

Will they be able to solve the mystery and save Raniwada from the curse of Jhamkudi?

Self - Founder of the Center for Public Integrity
Self - Professor at University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign
Self - Professor at New York University
Self - Visiting Prof. at Massachussets Institute of Technology

Hold your breath for the biggest undersea adventure of all!
48760: For the ventriloquist Gabbo his wooden dummy Otto is the only means of expression. When he starts relying more and more on Otto, he starts going mad.
Hated by all-his real soul spoke through the lips of a lifeless dummy

Will he ever get back to the sport that he loves?

An erotic thriller where vice is not sinful!

51576: A member of a Greek family in Turkey is forced to immigrate from Trabzon to Mersin in her youth. However, events cause her to face her own past.
